decision: Freeze configured field integration during correction-only work and require three reminders: project entry, architecture/owning modules, and before-edit/before-install scope review.
reason: The user requires the already configured behavior inside fields to remain stable while autocorrection evolves. Shared observation/state changes must not be described as browser-local merely because the new caller is KDE/Chrome.
verification: Run the existing architecture-canon link/change-record checks and their focused Python regressions; compare hashes of already modified runtime files and protected unchanged route files before/after this documentation-only change. Verify all three reminder links and desktop README links resolve.
not_tested: This rule change does not execute native input, accept the current experimental candidate, refactor adapters, introduce an automatic per-client scope guard, or establish unchanged GNOME/KDE behavior.
user_authorization: 2026-10-28: isolate configured field behavior from autocorrection changes; write the rule everywhere with three levels of reminders.
